items.answer: Buy Silver (3 coins). Trash all 4 other cards: 2 Estates + 2 Coppers with Chapel. This is the classic Chapel strategy — aggressively thin your deck to just Chapel + Silver + remaining Coppers. A thin deck cycles fast, hitting Gold/Province consistently. Never trash Chapel itself — it remains useful mid-game to remove Estates gained later.

items.answer: Buy a Laboratory or Festival. Laboratory (+2 Cards, +1 Action) is the premier cantrip — it draws and maintains actions. Festival (+2 Actions, +1 Buy, +2 Coins) provides payload and village effect. For an engine, Laboratory is slightly preferred early because draw is harder to get than actions in this kingdom. Market is also acceptable but weaker than Lab.

items.answer: Yes, pivot to Gardens. Buy a Workshop — it gains cards costing up to 4 (including Gardens and Workshop). The Gardens rush strategy: gain as many cards as possible (target 50+ cards = 5 VP each). Workshop gains Gardens directly. Village provides actions to play multiple Workshops. With 10 cards, Gardens currently scores 1 VP each — you need volume. Also gain cheap cards (Copper is free) to inflate deck size.
